title: YouTube to pay $24.5m to settle Trump lawsuit over Capitol riot
summary: The streaming giant is the last company to settle with the president after suspending his account in the wake of the 6 January attack in 2021.

title: YouTube agrees to pay Trump $24 million to settle lawsuit over Jan. 6 suspension
summary: YouTube is the latest social media company to pay Trump tens of millions of dollars to resolve lawsuits brought before he returned to power. The money will fund a new ballroom at the White House.

title: Trump obtains another settlement as YouTube agrees to pay $24.5 million
summary: Alphabet settles with Trump instead of fighting lawsuit over January 6 suspension.

title: Zijin Gold to Debut in HK After Biggest Global IPO Since May
summary: Zijin Gold International Co. will start trading in Hong Kong on Tuesday after the international unit of China’s biggest miner raised $3.2 billion in the world’s largest initial public offering since May.

title: China Stock Rally Seen Cooling on Fading AI Hype, Weak Support
summary: Chinese stocks’ recent momentum may taper by year-end as valuations stretch, market watchers say, clouding optimism that AI breakthroughs and support policies will drive a lasting rebound.
